label: NVIDIA Mellanox SN2410
description: NVIDIA Mellanox Spectrum SN2410 1RU open Ethernet leaf: 48x 25G SFP28 downlinks plus 8x 100G QSFP28 uplinks, 4 Tbps, short-depth with redundant PSUs. Ships with Onyx, Cumulus Linux or ONIE; QSFP28 uplinks break out to 4x 25G or 2x 50G.

fabric.note: Vendor throughput 4 Tb/s (2.97 Bpps) from the SN2410 product brief KEY FEATURES, and it is the full-duplex aggregate of the cages: 48 x 25GbE x 2 (2400 Gbit/s) + 8 x 100GbE x 2 (1600 Gbit/s) = 4000 Gbit/s. Breakout does not change it: the same 48 SFP28 cages can also run 34 x 50GbE total with the QSFP28 ports split 2x50GbE. Source: https://network.nvidia.com/files/doc-2020/pb-sn2410.pdf

notes: SN2410 (MSN2410-CB2F Onyx / -CB2FC Cumulus / -CB2FO ONIE, plus the C2P-airflow 'R' codes): 48 x SFP28 at 10/25GbE and 8 x QSFP28 at 40/100GbE in a full-width 1RU, 4 Tb/s, 2.97 Bpps, from the SN2410 product brief. Physical, from the brief's power and physical table: 43.8 mm (H) x 438 mm (W) x 436 mm (D), 8.52 kg, 165 W typical with passive cables (ATIS), 100-127 VAC and 200-240 VAC input, dual PSUs, short depth. Ports split: 100GbE to 4x25GbE or 2x50GbE, 40GbE to 4x10GbE. ONIE-bootable, with Onyx, Cumulus Linux or ONIE depending on the order code - the boot/firmware image is a SKU property. Management: one 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 MGT port and a USB console port (the brief lists a USB console port for management); no RJ45 serial console, and no PoE on any port. L2/L3 per the brief: MLAG, 802.1Q 4K VLANs, 802.1w and 802.1s, 802.3ad LACP (64 groups, 32 ports per channel), 64 VRFs, BGP4, OSPFv2, VRRP, PIM-SM and PIM-SSM, 64-way ECMP, VXLAN EVPN hardware VTEP, PTP IEEE-1588, sFlow, dual software images, 9216-byte jumbo frames. Correction recorded this run: the entry previously carried ports and a source URL but no fabric capacity, no management or console ports and no power/physical provenance. Sources: https://network.nvidia.com/files/doc-2020/pb-sn2410.pdf and https://docs.nvidia.com/networking/display/nvidia-spectrum-sn2000-1u-switch-systems-hardware-user-manual.pdf
